title: Ball tracking lost
description: Home keeps the ball down the right, then ball tracking is lost for 4 seconds. Players stay visible: away #3 tackles during the gap, and the ball reappears with away.

provenance.statement: Synthetic data, scripted in tools/export_scenarios.py. No competition data was read. Model labels are the unchanged Python engines' output.

events.description: The ball is not tracked for 100 frames (4.0 s); players still are.
Away #3 tackles home #7 and takes the ball, while the ball is untracked.
Ball tracking resumes, with the ball at away #3's feet.

reference.description: Written down from the scenario script, not produced by any model.
